description:
Create Skincare Content People Can Actually See Working

Mudzyme™ brings the professional facial experience home — with visible results in just 15–20 minutes.

That makes it especially creator-friendly. Apply the mask, let it work, rinse, and reveal. The tightening, smoothing, freshly-treated look gives you a natural story to capture on camera — from application to reaction to the final reveal.

Mudzyme is the flagship facial mask from Nature’s Skin & Body, a Nashville-based cosmetics manufacturer with decades of natural formulation experience. We make our products ourselves in our own U.S. facility.

What makes Mudzyme different? It combines rare earth mineral clay with fresh papaya and pineapple enzymes extracted from real fruit to create a dual-action facial treatment designed to tighten, exfoliate, and renew the look of skin.

We’re looking for creators who make authentic skincare, beauty, wellness, and clean-beauty content on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube.

Show the application. Capture the experience. Film the reveal. Tell your audience what you genuinely think.

No scripts. No agency middleman. No complicated content approval process.

As a Mudzyme Creator, you’ll receive:

• 25% commission on every qualifying sale
• 60-day cookie window
• Free full-size Mudzyme after approval
• Direct access to Bill Jordan, founder and formulator
• A visually demonstrable product built for authentic before-and-after content

We’re interested in building relationships with creators who genuinely connect with the product — not simply collecting affiliate links.

Not a fit: coupon sites, comparison-shopping sites, link-only accounts, or accounts without original content.
payout_period: Approved commissions are paid monthly via PayPal on the 15th of each month, for commissions from the previous month.
